008package paint.viewer.override.recording_override;
009
010import paint.shared.utils.TextFiles;
011import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;
012
013import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
014import paint.viewer.model.RecordingEntry;
015import tech.tablesaw.api.Table;
016
017import java.nio.file.Files;
018import java.nio.file.Path;
019import java.util.ArrayList;
020import java.util.HashMap;
021import java.util.List;
022import java.util.Map;
023
024/**
025 * Imports and applies recording-level threshold overrides to a collection of
026 * {@link RecordingEntry} objects.
027 * <p>
028 * Overrides are loaded from <project>/Viewer/Recording Override.csv. Each row
029 * specifies the updated threshold values for a single recording. Rows are matched
030 * to {@link RecordingEntry} objects using a composite key:
031 * {@code experimentName + "§" + recordingName}.
032 * <p>
033 * This class performs in-memory mutation only (no file writes).
034 */
035public final class ImportRecordingOverride {
036
037    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
038    // PUBLIC ENTRY POINT
039    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
040
041    /**
042     * Loads and applies all recording overrides to the given list of
043     * {@link RecordingEntry} objects.
044     * <p>
045     * If <project>/Viewer/Recording Override.csv does not exist, this method
046     * returns immediately without modifying anything.
047     *
048     * @param recordingEntries list of in-memory {@link RecordingEntry} objects to update
049     * @param projectPath      project root folder containing the {@code Viewer} directory
050     */
051    public static void importRecordingOverrides(List<RecordingEntry> recordingEntries, Path projectPath) {
052
053        Path csvPath = projectPath.resolve("Viewer").resolve("Recording Override.csv");
054
055        if (!Files.exists(csvPath)) {
056            PaintLogger.infof("No Recording Override.csv present - no overrides to apply.");
057            return;
058        }
059
060        List<RecordingOverride> overrides = loadRecordingOverride(csvPath);
061        applyInternal(recordingEntries, overrides);
062    }
063
064    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
065    // INTERNAL APPLY
066    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
067
068    /**
069     * Applies overrides that were already loaded from CSV.
070     * <p>
071     * Implementation notes:
072     * <ul>
073     *   <li>Builds a composite-key map for O(1) override lookup.</li>
074     *   <li>Mutates {@link RecordingEntry} recording threshold fields in place.</li>
075     *   <li>Logs only fields whose values changed.</li>
076     * </ul>
077     *
078     * @param entries   recording entries to update
079     * @param overrides overrides parsed from CSV
080     */
081    private static void applyInternal(List<RecordingEntry> entries, List<RecordingOverride> overrides) {
082
083        Map<String, RecordingOverride> map = new HashMap<>();
084
085        for (RecordingOverride override : overrides) {
086            map.put(key(override.getExperimentName(), override.getRecordingName()), override);
087        }
088
089
090        for (RecordingEntry entry : entries) {
091
092            String experimentName = entry.getExperimentName();
093            String recordingName  = entry.getRecordingName();
094
095            RecordingOverride override = map.get(key(experimentName, recordingName));
096
097            if (override != null) {
098
099                // Capture current values for change-only logging
100                double oldDensityRatio   = entry.getRecording().getMinRequiredDensityRatio();
101                double oldRSquared       = entry.getRecording().getMinRequiredRSquared();
102                double oldVariability    = entry.getRecording().getMaxAllowableVariability();
103                String oldNeighbourMode  = entry.getRecording().getNeighbourMode();
104
105                // Apply overrides (in-memory only)
106                entry.getRecording().setMinRequiredDensityRatio(override.getMinRequiredDensityRatio());
107                entry.getRecording().setMinRequiredRSquared(override.getMinRequiredRSquared());
108                entry.getRecording().setMaxAllowableVariability(override.getMaxAllowableVariability());
109                entry.getRecording().setNeighbourMode(override.getNeighbourMode());
110
111                // Log what changed for this recording
112                PaintLogger.infof(
113                        "Applied Recording override on %s",
114                        entry.getRecordingName());
115
116                if (oldDensityRatio != override.getMinRequiredDensityRatio()) {
117                    PaintLogger.infof("                    DensityRatio:   %-6.2f → %.2f",
118                                      oldDensityRatio, override.getMinRequiredDensityRatio());
119                }
120
121                if (oldRSquared != override.getMinRequiredRSquared()) {
122                    PaintLogger.infof("                    R²:             %-6.2f → %.2f",
123                                      oldRSquared,
124                                      override.getMinRequiredRSquared());
125                }
126
127                if (oldVariability != override.getMaxAllowableVariability()) {
128                    PaintLogger.infof("                    Variability:    %-6.2f → %.2f",
129                                      oldVariability,
130                                      override.getMaxAllowableVariability());
131                }
132
133                if (!oldNeighbourMode.equals(override.getNeighbourMode())) {
134                    PaintLogger.infof("                    Neighbour Mode: %6s → %s",
135                                      oldNeighbourMode,
136                                      override.getNeighbourMode());
137                }
138                PaintLogger.blankline();
139            }
140        }
141    }
142
143    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
144    // CSV LOADING
145    // ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
146
147    /**
148     * Loads all rows from {@code Recording Override.csv} into a list of
149     * {@link RecordingOverride} objects.
150     *
151     * @param csvFile path to {@code Recording Override.csv}
152     * @return list of parsed {@link RecordingOverride} objects (possibly empty)
153     */
154    public static List<RecordingOverride> loadRecordingOverride(Path csvFile) {
155
156        List<RecordingOverride> list = new ArrayList<>();
157
158        try {
159            Table table = Table.read().usingOptions(TextFiles.csvReadOptions(csvFile));
160
161            for (int i = 0; i < table.rowCount(); i++) {
162                RecordingOverride recordingOverride = new RecordingOverride();
163
164                recordingOverride.setExperimentName(          table.column(EXPERIMENT_NAME).get(i).toString());
165                recordingOverride.setRecordingName(           table.column(RECORDING_NAME).get(i).toString());
166                recordingOverride.setMinRequiredDensityRatio( Double.parseDouble(table.column(MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO).get(i).toString()));
167                recordingOverride.setMinRequiredRSquared(     Double.parseDouble(table.column(MIN_REQUIRED_R_SQUARED).get(i).toString()));
168                recordingOverride.setMaxAllowableVariability( Double.parseDouble(table.column(MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY).get(i).toString()));
169                recordingOverride.setNeighbourMode(           table.column(NEIGHBOUR_MODE).get(i).toString());
170
171                list.add(recordingOverride);
172            }
173        } catch (Exception ex) {
174            PaintLogger.errorf( "Error reading Recording Override.csv → " + ex.getMessage());
175        }
176
177        return list;
178    }
179
180    /**
181     * Builds the composite key used for override lookups.
182     *
183     * @param experimentName experiment name
184     * @param recordingName  recording name
185     * @return composite key in the format {@code experimentName + "§" + recordingName}
186     */
187    private static String key(String experimentName, String recordingName) {
188        return experimentName + "§" + recordingName;
189    }
190
191    /** Utility class; not instantiable. */
192    private ImportRecordingOverride() {}
193}
